data.name: Moshe
data.gender_notes: Moshe is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew verb 'mosheh' which means 'to draw out'. This name was given to Moses, who was drawn from the Nile River as a baby and raised by Pharaoh's daughter. The name Moshe carries the meaning “Drawn out of the water” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Moshe usually hope their child will grow to embody drawn out of the water and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes deliverance from hardship and adoption into a new family.
data.etymology: Moshe belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Drawn out of the water.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moshe total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: משה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: משה הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מושע ה' הוציאו מעבדות לחרות', על שם הנביא והמנהיג משה שהוציא את בני ישראל מעבדות במצרים והוביל אותם לחרות. השם משה הוא מקור חשוב לנצרות וליהדות כאחד, והוא מסמל את הגאולה והשחרור מרע.

in_greek.name: Μωυσής
in_greek.long_meaning: Μωυσής είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του εβραϊκού ονόματος משה, που σημαίνει 'ο δοῦλος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐλευθερώσας' ή 'ο Θεός ἔσωσε'. Στο Χριστιανισμό, ο Μωυσής θεωρείται σημαντική προσωπικότητα, καθώς συνδέεται με την παλαιά διαθήκη και την προετοιμασία για την έλευση του Ιησού Χριστού.

in_latin.name: Moses
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Moses a verbo hebraeo 'msh' derivatur, quod 'salvus a Deo vel liberator' significat. In traditione christiana, Moses figura importantissima habetur, quae populum Israeliticum a servitute Aegypti liberavit et ad libertatem perduxit, praefigurans liberationem per Christum.

in_english.name: Moshe
in_english.meaning: saved from the water or liberator
in_english.long_meaning: The name Moshe originates from Hebrew, meaning 'saved from the water or liberator'. It is associated with Moses, the biblical figure who led the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt. In Christianity, Moshe symbolizes redemption and freedom, reflecting Jesus Christ's role as savior. The name Moshe carries significant historical and spiritual weight across Jewish and Christian traditions.

data.cultural_impact: In the Hebrew Bible and Jewish tradition, Moses is regarded as a lawgiver and the leader who led the Israelites out of Egyptian slavery to the land of Canaan. He is considered one of the greatest figures in Judaism and is held in high regard in Christianity as well.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian theology, Moses is a prophet and a type of Christ. He led the Israelites to freedom from slavery and brought them to the promise land, which can be seen as a foreshadowing of Christ's role in leading humanity to salvation and the promise of eternal life. Additionally, Moses' role as a mediator between God and the people is significant, as Christ also serves as a mediator between God and humanity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Moshe, meaning "drawn out of the water" in Hebrew, symbolizes God's intervention in saving and choosing His chosen leader, Moses, from the perils of infanticide and the slavery of Egypt, setting him on a path to lead the Israelites to freedom.

biblical_reference.note: The name Moshe is given to Moses by Pharaoh's daughter, as she drew him out of the water.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Moses was a Hebrew prophet, born in Egypt during the 13th century BCE. The name Moshe carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
Historical records show that Moses led the Israelites out of Egypt and received the Ten Commandments from God on Mount Sinai. The name Moshe carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Moshe remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Moshe from Jerusalem, Israel embodies the meaning of Moshe - "Drawn out of the water". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
